content:
Inspired by #41457, I performed a search over mathlib for sibling APIs that could possibly be subsumed by some common generalization. One of the finds were these:

-- Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/BooleanRing.lean      [BooleanRing α]
theorem BooleanRing.add_self    : a + a = 0
theorem BooleanRing.neg_eq      : -a = a
theorem BooleanRing.sub_eq_add  : a - b = a + b

-- Mathlib/Algebra/CharP/Two.lean             [Ring R] [CharP R 2]
theorem CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero : x + x = 0
theorem CharTwo.neg_eq           : -x = x
theorem CharTwo.sub_eq_add       : x - y = x + y

-- Mathlib/Data/ZMod/Basic.lean               [AddCommGroup G] [Module (ZMod 2) G]
lemma ZModModule.add_self     : x + x = 0
lemma ZModModule.neg_eq_self  : -x = x
lemma ZModModule.sub_eq_add   : x - y = x + y

All three hypothesis sets are used only to establish ∀ x, x + x = 0, so each lemma could potentially be stated once against a Prop mixin.

I have a POC for this, so I know it works in principle. But is it valuable enough to warrant a PR?
Will it deduplicate more than this 3x3 square of lemmas? Because if it's only these, then I wouldn't bother. But if it is 3xN for N >> 10, then it becomes quite interesting.

These 3x3 ones are the intersection of the three files, but there are more theorems that would make sense to state against the mixin. Algebra/CharP/Two.lean has 11 lemmas, which the other two would then get for free.

There are also some generalizations to be had by doing this. E.g.:

  • [IsCancelMul G] is unnecessary on Commute.of_orderOf_dvd_two, mul_comm_of_exponent_two and commMonoidOfExponentTwo since the mixin can give us commutativity without cancellation.
  • add_eq_zero, add_eq_iff_eq_add, eq_add_iff_add_eq: Ring → AddMonoid

It might be easier to evaluate the downstream consequences by seeing the actual POC, so I published it as a draft here: https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/43575/

A warning: the draft is vibe-coded in it's entirety, so don't take any of the specifics in it too seriously. This is just a sandbox for me to explore the downstream consequences of the added mixins.
